tasks.subject: Task 1: Schema patch and TypeScript types
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Apply database schema changes for the suppliers module and define TypeScript types.

**Files:**
- Create: `supabase/patches/suppliers_module.sql`
- Create: `src/lib/suppliers/types.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] suppliers table extended with 10 new columns
- [ ] supplier_contacts, supplier_components, supplier_component_price_breaks tables created with RLS
- [ ] purchase_order.expected_date added
- [ ] purchase_order_line.unit_cost added
- [ ] TypeScript types compile

**Verify:** `npx tsc --noEmit` → no errors

```json:metadata
{"files": ["supabase/patches/suppliers_module.sql", "src/lib/suppliers/types.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npx tsc --noEmit", "acceptanceCriteria": ["suppliers table extended", "3 new tables with RLS", "purchase_order.expected_date added", "purchase_order_line.unit_cost added", "TypeScript types compile"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Catalog logic and tests
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Implement pure logic functions and Supabase data-fetching for avg actual lead times and price break resolution.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/lib/suppliers/catalog.ts`
- Create: `src/lib/suppliers/catalog.test.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] deriveLeadTimeStatus correct
- [ ] resolvePriceForQuantity correct
- [ ] getAvgActualLeadTimes returns Map keyed by componentId
- [ ] getAvgActualLeadTimesForComponent returns Map keyed by supplierId
- [ ] All tests pass

**Verify:** `npx vitest run src/lib/suppliers/catalog.test.ts` → all tests pass

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/lib/suppliers/catalog.ts", "src/lib/suppliers/catalog.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npx vitest run src/lib/suppliers/catalog.test.ts", "acceptanceCriteria": ["deriveLeadTimeStatus correct", "resolvePriceForQuantity correct", "getAvgActualLeadTimes works", "getAvgActualLeadTimesForComponent works", "all tests pass"]}
```
